title: New clients take too long to go live
disclaimer: Practice scenario. The company is fictional and every figure is hypothetical. Australian market context is general.
company_context: ClearTrace (fictional) is an Australian regtech SaaS that helps banks, fintechs and remitters monitor transactions and submit AUSTRAC reports.

brief.problem: New clients are taking much longer to go live, so new revenue lands late and some deals are cancelling.
brief.objective: Cut median time to go-live from 21 weeks back to 12 within nine months.
baseline: Median time from contract to go-live: 21 weeks, up from 11 a year ago.
New contracts: about 8 a quarter, averaging $150k annual recurring revenue (ARR).

facts.answer: Revenue starts at go-live. Ten extra weeks across 8 contracts a quarter at $150k ARR delays about $230k of revenue each quarter. Two contracts cancelled in the last six months, losing $300k ARR.
facts.coach_tip: Name both: delayed revenue and lost deals.
facts.model_question: What's the revenue impact of slower go-lives?

facts.answer: Go-live means the first production transaction is screened and the client's first AUSTRAC report is submitted from the platform.
facts.coach_tip: Go-live depends on the client's data flowing — a clue.

facts.answer: Small fintechs and remitters (under 50 staff): median 26 weeks, up from 10. Banks: 15 weeks, up from 13.
Small clients spend a median 11 weeks in data mapping. 5 of 9 stalled small clients have no in-house data engineer.
facts.coach_tip: They lack skills for a technical step — note it.
facts.model_question: Where do small clients get stuck, and why?

facts.answer: Median weeks for small clients: kickoff 1 → data mapping 11 (was 3) → rules configuration 6 → UAT 5 → go-live 3.
facts.coach_tip: Data mapping went from 3 to 11 weeks — that's the break.
facts.model_question: Can I see the implementation stages and time in each?

facts.answer: Implementation runs through a client portal plus weekly calls with a ClearTrace implementation manager.
facts.coach_tip: Fine to check — the issue is the work itself.

facts.answer: Nine months ago the platform moved to a new data model that needs clients to map transactions to ISO 20022 fields. Pre-built connectors for common core banking and remittance systems were not rebuilt for the new model.
facts.coach_tip: Link this to the mapping time jump.
facts.model_question: Did anything change in the platform or implementation process?

facts.answer: Implementation CSAT fell from 8.6 to 5.9 out of 10. Themes: field mapping is unclear 41%, no connector for our system 33%, too many UAT rounds 15%.
facts.coach_tip: Mapping and connectors cover 74% of complaints.
facts.model_question: What are new clients saying about implementation?

facts.answer: The implementation team has 6 managers handling about 5 projects each, with a backlog of 14 projects.
facts.coach_tip: Capacity is tight — any fix must reduce effort, not add it.

facts.answer: Two competitors launched lower-priced plans, but our sales win rate is steady at 32%.
facts.coach_tip: Sales are fine — the problem is after signing.

facts.answer: Estimates: a partner data-mapping service — 2 weeks to set up, no build. Guided mapping templates with sample files — 4 weeks. Rebuild connectors for the top 5 source systems — 12 weeks.
facts.coach_tip: Map these to quick fix, medium and big bet.
facts.model_question: What are our options and estimates?

model_answer.problem_statement: Small fintech and remitter clients are stuck in data mapping — now 11 weeks, up from 3 — because the new ISO 20022 data model has no pre-built connectors, pushing their go-live from 10 to 26 weeks and delaying about $230k of revenue a quarter.

options.name: Partner mapping service
options.description: Refer small clients to a paid data-mapping partner.
options.customer_impact: Experts do the mapping for them.
options.why: Quick, but shifts cost to clients.

options.name: Guided mapping templates
options.description: Templates and sample files for common systems, with field-by-field guidance.
options.customer_impact: Clear steps without a data engineer.
options.business_impact: Targets the 41% 'unclear mapping' theme; could cut mapping to about 5 weeks.
options.why: Best impact for effort, scales across clients.

options.name: Rebuild top 5 connectors
options.description: Pre-built connectors for the 5 most common source systems.
options.business_impact: Removes most mapping for covered systems.
options.why: Root-cause fix, but slow to land.

model_answer.decision: Ship guided mapping templates in 4 weeks, offer the partner service right away for stalled clients, and start rebuilding the top 5 connectors next.
model_answer.hypothesis: If we give small clients guided mapping templates with sample files, data mapping will fall from 11 to 5 weeks and median go-live from 26 to 16 weeks within two quarters, because 41% of complaints cite unclear field mapping.
model_answer.test: Pilot with the next 6 small-client implementations vs the current process.
